title: Hi, I want to create a new customer account on Auxin. How do I register?
query: Hi, I want to create a new customer account on Auxin. How do I register?
answer: Welcome to Auxin! To create your customer account, open the app or website and head to the authentication page. Select the 'Sign Up' tab, choose 'Customer' as your role, enter your mobile phone number, and set a password. After submitting, you will receive a 6-digit OTP on your mobile number for verification. Once verified, your account is immediately ready for browsing and shopping fresh produce!
content:
Question: Hi, I want to create a new customer account on Auxin. How do I register?

Select the 'Sign Up' tab, choose 'Customer' as your role, enter your mobile phone number, and set a password. After submitting, you will receive a 6-digit OTP on your mobile number for verification. Once verified, your account is immediately ready for browsing and shopping fresh produce!

If you still don't receive it, ensure DND (Do Not Disturb) settings on your mobile service provider are not blocking transaction messages.

title: What payment options are available at checkout?
query: What payment options are available at checkout?
answer: Auxin supports two secure payment methods: 1. **Online Payment (Razorpay Escrow)**: Pay via Credit/Debit Card, Netbanking, UPI, or Wallets. Payment is held securely in escrow until delivery is verified. 2. **Cash on Delivery (COD)**: Pay the delivery partner directly in cash upon receiving your produce and validating your delivery OTP.
